content: I wanted to make an docs#IsOrderedAddMonoid instance, but I was surprised that it requires Monoid. Okay, shouldn't have been surprised given the name, but I meant, why does it require a zero element? It seems like the typeclass itself (since it's a mixin and not an extension) should only require Add and Preorder. Example: PNat, PosNum, both have ordered addition but no additive identity.
Confusingly there is Lean.Grind.OrderedAdd but that actually is considerably stronger, and corresponds to addition also being cancellative.
This is to avoid unexpected performance impacts from the refactor. I left a comment here noting that they can be weakened in the future.
I think it makes sense to weaken, but it would also then make sense to rename to something like IsOrderedAdd (and IsOrderedMul)
Just realized there's docs#AddLeftMono and docs#AddRightMono which are essentially what I was describing.
